notes.title: Hodge's Journey - A Tail of an Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Team Lunar here with an update for those of you enjoying Another Sight - Hodge's Journey! 

Our team have been hard at work listening to your feedback from playing Hodge's prequel story and we have made some tweaks and changes to make the experience even better! 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33860439/2d8fd79cf8bbac0393655d57dc5f6cc33f746c5e.png

So put your paws up, relax and take in the details of what we have in store. 

- Completely new and precise jumping system added
- Improvements on cat responsiveness 
- Improved physics for Hodge
- Better control on jump length
- Better level tuning
- Difficulty level optimization addressed

Please enjoy this update and do keep your feedback coming! 

Stay tuned for more updates and details! 

-- Team Lunar!

notes.title: When Hodge Met Kit...
notes.content:
Another Sight - Hodge's Journey is a prequel adventure that puts players exclusively in the paws of Hodge, the mysterious cat! 

Prowl, pounce and meow through a new adventure that chronicles the journey of Hodge on his journey to discover Kit at the start of her Another Sight journey!

 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33860439/2d8fd79cf8bbac0393655d57dc5f6cc33f746c5e.png

Players and fans quickly fell in love with Hodge in Another Sight and wanted to know more about this mysterious feline, so our team have been hard at work to craft this stand alone prequel adventure for free to all on Steam - you don't even need the main game to download and play! 

We hope you all enjoy this new [strike]tail[/strike] tale! 

-- Team Lunar
